title: Spotify launches a "Verified by Spotify" badge for podcasts to help "authenticate creator identity", after releasing it for music in April (Lawrence Bonk/Engadget)
summary: Lawrence Bonk / Engadget: Spotify launches a “Verified by Spotify” badge for podcasts to help “authenticate creator identity”, after releasing it for music in April — The platform recently did something similar for music. — Spotify is launching verification badges for podcasts to help “authenticate creator identity and likeness.”
contentText:
Lawrence Bonk / Engadget :

Spotify launches a “Verified by Spotify” badge for podcasts to help “authenticate creator identity”, after releasing it for music in April   —  The platform recently did something similar for music.  —  Spotify is launching verification badges for podcasts to help “authenticate creator identity and likeness.”
